    checks.append(dict(check=name,passed=bool(ok),detail=detail))
def near(a,b,tol=1e-7): return bool(np.allclose(a,b,atol=tol,rtol=1e-9))
def lp(*args,**kw):
    if len(calls)>=12: raise RuntimeError('Independent LP budget exceeded')
    calls.append(dict(call=len(calls)+1,kind=active))
    ans=scipy_lp(*args,**kw)
    calls[-1].update(success=bool(ans.success),status=int(ans.status),objective=float(ans.fun) if ans.success else None)
    if not ans.success: raise RuntimeError(ans.message)
    return ans
def settlement(g,a,p):
    return p*min(g,a)+F(3,2)*p*max(a-g,0)+F(1,2)*p*max(g-a,0)
for g,a,p in [(100,80,1),(100,150,1),(100,0,1),(0,20,1),(100,80,2),(100,100,1)]:
    exact=settlement(F(g),F(a),F(p))
    got=ref.ordinary_cost(np.array([g]),np.array([a]),np.array([p]))[0]
    ck('独立分段普通费_'+str((g,a,p)),near(got,float(exact)),dict(actual=float(got),expected=str(exact)))

path=[100,150,80]
